column1: # Babi's scholars: research, Alchemy, the buried ruins and Kraden's absence.

column3:
Babi sends us from one
experiment to the next.
His questions never end.{page_break}Kraden was his finest
scholar. I wonder where
he is now.{end_wait}

The experiment fails
again. I have repeated
it until my hands shake.{page_break}Kraden warned me that
my understanding of
Alchemy was shallow.{end_wait}

They say Alchemy was
sealed away long ago.
Who had the right to do it?{page_break}And what were they
afraid would happen if
it remained in our hands?{end_wait}
The Venus Ruins lie\nbeneath the tower, older\nthan any record we own.{end_wait}

The lighthouse stands
where the ancient ruins
were once buried.{page_break}A tunnel runs beneath
them. Its end has never
been found.{end_wait}

No one has reached the
tunnel's end. Some say
there is no end at all.{page_break}I would still like to
know what lies beneath
those stones.{end_wait}

My experiments are
finally yielding results.
Slowly, but surely.{page_break}Perhaps Kraden was right
about the direction
our research should take.{end_wait}

Kraden left to restore
the lost art of Alchemy.
That was Babi's hope.{page_break}He was also meant to
learn why the world
turned away from it.{end_wait}

The Venus Ruins belonged
to a civilization that
understood great power.{page_break}Babi's lighthouse rises
from its foundation. I
fear what that means.{end_wait}

Babi expected answers
from Kraden's journey.
He has received none.{page_break}I wonder whether the
old man knew more than
he ever told us.{end_wait}
You know Kraden,\ndon't you? Have you\nspoken with him?{end_now}

We have not heard from
him in years... To think
he was in your village!{page_break}I wonder whether he
found the legendary
Elemental Stars?{end_wait}

I'm surprised no one
in Vale knew he came
from Tolbi.{page_break}Why did Kraden never
tell anyone about
this place?{end_wait}

When the lighthouse is
finished, I want to move
there and study the ruins.{page_break}Perhaps the stones will
answer what our books
never could.{end_wait}

Alchemy speaks of four
foundations: earth, water,
fire, and wind.{page_break}All things take shape
from that union. It once
changed the world.{end_wait}

If we understood the
Venus Ruins, Babi might
never have built the tower.{page_break}We study the old stones,
but the answer remains
out of reach.{end_wait}

Kraden would visit if he
returned to Tolbi. Babi
thought highly of him.{page_break}I hope he found what he
was seeking. I hope he
is still alive.{end_wait}

Alchemy and the Venus
Ruins are bound together.
I can feel the connection.{page_break}I will solve the riddle
myself, if it takes
my whole life.{end_wait}
I want to see Kraden\nagain. There is something\nI need to tell him.{end_wait}

There must be a reason
for the four Elements
being called great bases.{page_break}If we understood it,
perhaps we could change
lead into gold.{end_wait}
What secrets lie beneath\nthe Venus Ruins? The\nold stones keep silent.{end_wait}
Kraden has not returned.\nThere must be a reason.\nI fear it is a cruel one.{end_wait}
A book entitled\n"Encyclopedia of\nAncient Ruins."{end_wait}

A notebook entitled
"Experiments in
Alchemy."{page_break}"The experiment failed
again. I still have so
much to ask Kraden..."{end_wait}

A notebook entitled
"Study of the Venus
Ruins."{page_break}"Many ancient
civilizations still lie
buried in that region..."{end_wait}
